title: Real-Time WebSockets Engine (ferrox-front-ws)
description: ferrox-front-ws provides an asynchronous WebAssembly WebSocket client engine built natively for Rust frontends. It bridges browser WebSocket APIs (web_sys::WebSocket) with Ferrox Front's reactive Signals graph (Signal), enabling low-latency, real-time bi-directional streaming for dashboards, chat applications, financial tickers, and live notification systems.
